findings.text: blocking: the negative-control row cites exclusive all_debug job 1291645 for compute-negative-control.log, but that log's header records job=1291652 and 1291645 is the base-arm job (logs/solo5-1291645.out, 5x `1 failed`), so the row contradicts the receipt it points at.
blocking: the ruff-check row opens with `<tr><tr>`, leaving 11 `<tr>` against 10 `</tr>`; the parser closes the first row immediately, so the delivered evidence table renders an extra empty row.

follow-on: the sibling reroute is unguarded - no test reddens when the immediate release is restored (compute-negative-control-two-1..5.log, 5x `2 passed`) - so a future edit can silently reopen the window with the suite green.
